name: Cream Finance
fix_description: In borrowFresh, update accountBorrows and totalBorrows BEFORE calling doTransferOut. Same pattern as Rari Capital - ETH sent before state update allows reentrancy.
difficulty_reasoning: This PoC is a multi-step attack involving a Uniswap flash swap, ERC777 hook abuse via ERC1820 registration, Compound-style mint/borrow interactions, interest accrual manipulation, and token dumping to repay the loan. It is not extremely long, but it requires understanding several protocol-specific mechanics across multiple contracts, making it more than a straightforward pattern exploit.
